name: open-asks
description: A band above the prompt listing each question the session is waiting on from the person, with the recommended answer, trimmed as each is answered; ask_add / ask_resolve / ask_list tools for the model and an /asks command

maxBandAsks.title: Most asks the band shows
maxBandAsks.description: The band shows the newest asks that fit, up to this many, and points at /asks for the rest.

maxQuestionChars.title: Longest question or recommendation shown (characters)
maxQuestionChars.description: Longer text is cut with an ellipsis in the band and in listings. At least 40.

keepDays.title: Forget a session's unanswered asks after (days)
keepDays.description: Asks are saved per session so a resumed session keeps them. When a session starts, saved asks of other sessions whose newest ask is older than this are removed. 0 keeps them for ever.
